review.summary: The Worker completed all planned evidence reviews and supplied five concise, numbered, imperative, evidence-grounded proposed follow-ups in the summary. The actions appropriately address unavailable property validation, the outstanding buyer-recorded task, partial and unavailable research, due-diligence items requiring verification, and the lack of verified property-location context. However, the authoritative coverage check confirms that research coverage remains partial, so the proposed plan should be accepted only as a partial outcome pending the listed verification work.

limitations: Evidence is bounded to 10 shortlisted properties, 10 target suburbs, 10 distinct locality requests and the first 25 Sales research/Due diligence records.
Case target suburbs are buyer preferences, not verified property locations. Exact locality names do not establish geographic boundary equivalence.
Property discovery release coverage is retained; fixture, stale and partial coverage is not complete official evidence.
Only the first 25 saved records are matched by exact property reference; this is not an exhaustive search.
Case target context and verified property-location context are separate; neither is substituted for the other.
Only exact normalized NSW source localities are requested; no postcode or boundary inference.

findings: The buyer case status is “paused,” with a budget range of AUD 750,000 to AUD 1,200,000.

Property ref “95000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000012” has validation state “pending”; the Unit 10 property has validation state “unavailable.”
There is 1 buyer-recorded note for the Unit 10 property.
The note states: “Provider validation was unavailable when this snapshot was recorded.”
This note is marked within content identified as untrusted.
There is 1 recorded task: “Retry property validation.”
The task is linked to the Unit 10 property, is “completed”: false, and has due date “2026-09-06.”
The task text is buyer-recorded context and does not establish that validation was completed.
Overall research evidence is in state “partial”; Property discovery evidence for both shortlisted properties is “unavailable.”
Sales research matching for both properties is “partial,” and the evidence says only the first 25 saved records are matched by exact property reference.
Suburb-related target context is “unavailable”; the evidence states that target suburbs are buyer preferences and do not verify property locations.
For the Unit 10 property, visible Due diligence records include confirmed strata evidence, confirmed bushfire mapping of “Vegetation Category 1,” and an unavailable tribunal record.

Visible building-order evidence for the Unit 10 property includes both “non_intersection” and “partial_coverage” states; the latter summary reports building orders or rectification notices recorded against the building.
